changelog: **Session timeout warning (WCAG 2.2.1, #2864):** five minutes before an idle session ends, `SessionTimeoutWarning` (mounted in `app/providers.tsx`, signed-in only) opens an alert dialog with "Stay signed in", which calls next-auth's `update()` and re-issues the 12 h cookie. Timing lives in the pure `src/lib/sessionTimeoutRule.ts` (unit-tested); `e2e/session-timeout.spec.ts` drives it with a fast-forwarded browser clock. VPAT 2.2.1 now reads `Supports`.

en: Before you are signed out for inactivity, the app now warns you and lets you stay signed in with one click.
tr: Hareketsizlik nedeniyle oturumunuz kapanmadan önce uygulama artık sizi uyarıyor ve tek tıkla oturumu açık tutmanıza izin veriyor.
de: Bevor Sie wegen Inaktivität abgemeldet werden, warnt die App Sie jetzt und Sie bleiben mit einem Klick angemeldet.
